title: Growing Bacteria in B-Broth
author: Cristian Riccio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5xjg7kn

steps.title: Select isolated colony
steps.instruction: Locate an isolated colony of the target bacteria on an agar plate.

steps.title: Inoculate B‑broth
steps.instruction: Flame a pipette tip over a Bunsen burner, touch the colony with the tip, and drop the tip into a 100 mL bottle of B‑broth.

substeps.instruction: Flame the pipette tip over the Bunsen burner to sterilize it.
Touch the isolated colony with the sterile tip.
Immediately drop the tip into a 100 mL bottle containing B‑broth.

steps.title: Incubate culture
steps.instruction: Place the 100 mL bottle of B‑broth with the inoculated tip into an incubator set to 37 °C (suitable for E. coli).
